mapper.select: select case when gender = 1 Then "男性员工" else "女性员工" end as name, count(*) as value from emp group by gender
select case when job = 1 then "班主任" when job = 2 then "讲师" when job = 3 then "学工主管" when job = 4 then "教研主管" when job = 5 then "咨询师" else "其他" end as name ,count(*) as value from emp group by job

select case when degree = 1 then "初中" when degree = 2 then "高中" when degree = 3 then "专科" when degree = 4 then "本科" when degree = 5 then "研究生" end as name, count(*) as value from student group by degree
select c.name as name,count(*) as value from student s left outer join clazz c on s.clazz_id = c.id group by c.name;
